summary: Reviewed all 390 files of LeanPool/@subtrees/f across 14 vendored projects (AndersonConjecture, Apportionment, Biswal, Brouwer, DensityHalesJewett, Erdos346, MatchingLogic, NemytskiiLebesgue, PhaseRetrieval, PointwiseBirkhoff, QuantumParallelRepetition, RearrangementNumber, SeveralComplexVariables, SteinhausThreeGap). All 390 paths resolve in the checkout with the byte sizes given in the brief. A comment-stripped structural scan found 19 files whose only non-import content is at most an `@[expose] public section` line; I read the 16 flagged by keyword or scan in full (plus the 3 remaining section-bearing facades by scan). 7 are pure FILTER-007 import-only modules (DensityHalesJewett umbrella and six SeveralComplexVariables index modules); 12 carry an `@[expose] public section` command, which takes them outside the unilateral pure-import class. FILTER-007 assigns verified import-only modules to ranking (FD-016 navigation-import-only role), not removal, and their module paths and docstrings (the SeveralComplexVariables umbrella holds a long mathematical overview) are navigation signal users may search for; no FILTER-004 content-level exclusion basis exists. Every other file carries ordinary Lean declarations and proofs. Retain all 390 files.

summary: Inspected the single changed file LeanPool/AndersonConjecture/CompleteDomain/Domain.lean (13,310 bytes). It contains substantial formal mathematical content: definitions of the ideal (x²-yz) in ℂ[[x,y,z]], the quotient ring T, a substitution homomorphism ψ, and a complete proof that T is an integral domain (via injectivity of the factored map ψBar). The file carries `@[expose] public section` and numerous `def`, `lemma`, and `instance` declarations with proofs — not a pure import aggregator. It falls squarely within the primary mathematical-content index.
